name: ki-cl-moonshot-exercise
description: Ki.CL moonshot exercise - a federated module for Ki.CL that also runs standalone

scripts.development: yarn workspace @ki-cl/moonshot run types; yarn workspace @ki-cl/moonshot run dev
scripts.production: yarn build && NODE_ENV=production tsx --tsconfig Server/tsconfig.json Server/index.ts
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @ki-cl/moonshot run typecheck && yarn workspace @ki-cl/moonshot-server run typecheck

author: Keni Lam
